transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been way more driven and wired than usual for weeks, like I can’t slow down or stop starting new projects, and now it’s starting to blow up my job.
Have you ever had periods in the past where you felt the exact opposite—very down, depressed, or exhausted—or is this the first time you've experienced a major shift in your mood?

This is the first time I've ever experienced a major shift like this, and it all started right after my promotion. Even though I've been so wired, for the past four months I've also had these heavy, exhausted lows where I feel deeply fatigued and consumed by guilt that I've ruined the whole region's business. It gets so overwhelming at times that I've even thought it would be easier if I just didn't wake up.
Over these past four months, did the wired feeling and the heavy lows happen at the same time, or did you have a distinct period of depression followed by a separate period of feeling wired?

They’ve actually been happening at the same time rather than in separate, neat blocks. Underneath all this wired, nonstop running around, I’ve been feeling this heavy, worn-out, and guilty low for the past four months. It honestly feels like I’m carrying both of these extremes simultaneously.

Even though you mentioned this is your first major shift, looking back, have you ever had milder periods in your life—even just for a few days or weeks—where you felt unusually down, or on the flip side, unusually energetic and active?

I don't really recall having periods like this in the past. Before this promotion, my life and my mood felt pretty normal, stable, and calm. I never really experienced those kinds of extreme highs or lows back then.
To be absolutely sure, have you ever had a period in your life lasting at least two weeks where you lost interest in almost all activities you usually enjoy, or felt constantly down?

Yes, over the last four months I’ve definitely felt that deep, heavy downness. During this time, I completely lost interest in things I used to love, like my soccer league, hiking on Sundays, or even grabbing beers at shows. All of it just started to feel totally pointless.
Have you ever had a period in your past—even if it felt good or productive—where you needed much less sleep than usual for several days in a row, but still felt completely rested and full of energy?

No, I never had periods like that in my distant past before this promotion, but over the last few months, that is exactly what's been happening. I've only been getting two or three hours of sleep a night because my brain is buzzing, but I still feel insanely pumped up and driven to work on new projects instead of feeling tired.
Before these past four months, have you ever taken any medications for your mood or sleep, or seen a therapist or doctor for mental health reasons?
No, I’ve never seen a therapist or a doctor for my mental health before this current episode. I also haven't ever taken any kind of medications for my mood or sleep in the past.
In the past, before these last four months, did you ever have a period of several days where you felt extremely irritable, easily angered, or constantly picking fights with others?

No, I've never had any periods of extreme irritability or picking fights before all of this started. Before my promotion, my mood was really stable and I didn't experience those kinds of sudden, angry shifts.
Since these symptoms started around your promotion, have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or new prescription medications?

I haven't been using any recreational drugs or new prescription medications at all. The only thing is some light social drinking, like at craft-beer networking events for work, but nothing heavy or out of the ordinary.

Since these symptoms occur concurrently rather than in separate episodes, and there is no prior history of mood episodes, this meets the ICD-10 criteria for F38.0 (Other single mood [affective] disorders: Mixed affective episode).
